description: This file is a shell script used to test differences (diff) between symlinks and files within a git repository. It includes functions to compute object IDs, sets up various test scenarios, and verifies the diff output in different situations involving symlinks, including creation, deletion, modification, and attribute handling.

methods.name: symlink_oid
methods.description: Calculates and prints the short object ID of a symlink with the given name.

methods.name: short_oid
methods.description: Calculates and prints the short object ID of the given file.
